scenarios.title: A destroyed permanent moves from the battlefield to its owner's graveyard

setup.notes: Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: A casts Murder targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping three Swamps.

variants.label: destroyed
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is destroyed and moves from the battlefield to B's graveyard.

variants.label: indestructible
variants.delta: Murder targets Darksteel Myr instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Darksteel Myr is not destroyed and stays on the battlefield; Murder resolved and is in A's graveyard.

scenarios.title: Only a destroy effect or lethal or deathtouch damage destroys a permanent

setup.notes: Drudge Skeletons is a 1/1 with '{B}: Regenerate'. B's single Swamp pays for one regeneration. Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting Drudge Skeletons, tapping Mountain.
In response, B activates Drudge Skeletons' regeneration ability, tapping Swamp; both players pass and it resolves, creating a regeneration shield.
Both players pass; Shock resolves and the state-based check follows.

variants.label: lethal_damage
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to the 1/1. The lethal-damage state-based action destroys it, so the regeneration shield replaces the destruction: Drudge Skeletons stays on the battlefield, tapped, with its damage removed.

variants.label: toughness_zero
variants.delta: A casts Disfigure targeting Drudge Skeletons, tapping Swamp, instead of Shock.
variants.expected: Drudge Skeletons becomes -1/-1 and is put into B's graveyard by the toughness-0 state-based action. It was not destroyed, so the regeneration shield does not apply.

variants.label: sacrificed
variants.delta: A casts Diabolic Edict targeting B, tapping Mountain and Swamp, instead of Shock.
variants.expected: B sacrifices Drudge Skeletons, their only creature, and it moves to B's graveyard. A sacrifice is not a destruction, so the regeneration shield does not apply.

scenarios.title: A regeneration shield replaces a destroy effect

setup.notes: Drudge Skeletons is a 1/1 with '{B}: Regenerate'. Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: A casts Murder targeting Drudge Skeletons, tapping three Swamps.
In response, B activates Drudge Skeletons' regeneration ability, tapping Swamp; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: regenerated
variants.expected: The destruction is replaced: Drudge Skeletons is tapped, has its damage removed, and stays on the battlefield. Murder is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: no_shield
variants.delta: B does not activate the regeneration ability.
variants.expected: Drudge Skeletons is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: cannot_regenerate
variants.delta: A casts Wrath of God instead of Murder, tapping two Plains and two Swamps; B still activates the regeneration ability in response.
variants.expected: Wrath of God destroys Drudge Skeletons and it can't be regenerated, so the shield is not used: Drudge Skeletons moves to B's graveyard.

scenarios.title: A regenerated creature is removed from combat

setup.notes: Hill Giant is not summoning sick. Drudge Skeletons is a 1/1 with '{B}: Regenerate'. B's single Swamp pays for one regeneration. Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: A attacks B with Hill Giant.
B declares Drudge Skeletons as a blocker of Hill Giant.
B activates Drudge Skeletons' regeneration ability, tapping Swamp; both players pass and it resolves.
Both players pass; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: regenerated
variants.expected: Hill Giant deals 3 damage to Drudge Skeletons and Drudge Skeletons deals 1 damage to Hill Giant. The destruction of Drudge Skeletons is replaced: it is tapped, removed from combat and has its damage removed, and stays on the battlefield. Hill Giant has 1 damage marked.

variants.label: no_shield
variants.delta: B does not activate the regeneration ability.
variants.expected: Drudge Skeletons is destroyed by the 3 damage and moves to B's graveyard. Hill Giant has 1 damage marked.
